full_judgment: 22. The opposite party No. 1 as pre-emptor filed Pre-emption Misc. Case No. 17 of 1996 for pre-empting the land measuring 59 decimals of land in SA Khatian No. 248/288 under Mouza-Shakashar, PS Kaliakoir, District-Gazipur as described in Deed No. 4336 dated 1-8-1995 on the allegation that the pre-emptor-opposite party No. 1 is a co-sharer to the case jote inheritance, after the death of her father her sister, Monwara Begum transferred her share to pre-emptee-opposite party No. 1 beyond the knowledge of the pre-emptor by executing Deed No. 4336 dated 1-8-1995. The opposite party Nos. 1-2 in Order to defeat the right or pre-emption collusively and cunningly described the deed of transfer a deed of exchange. The pre-emptee-opposite party No.1 is a stranger to the case jote and as such the pre-emptor is entitled to pre-empt the land.
